products.name: LG 10 kg front-load washing machine with AI Direct Drive and Steam
products.summary: Open the door to see the drum, slide out the detergent drawer and open the pump-filter cover, then place it in your home at its real size.
products.arTip: Tap the door, the drawer or the small cover at the bottom right to open it
products.sizeNote: 61.5 cm deep with the door, 110 cm with the door open at 90 degrees

fit.note: From LG's owner's manual: at least 2 cm at each side, 10 cm behind for the hoses and air, 0.5 cm above, and 110 cm of depth in total with the door open at 90 degrees.

specs: AI Direct Drive, Inverter Direct Drive, 6 Motion Direct Drive
Stainless steel, embossed, with stainless steel slim lifters
Steam with Allergy Care and Baby Steam Care
Cotton, Cotton+, Mixed Fabric, Easy Care, Silent Wash, Allergy Care, Baby Steam Care, Delicates, Hand/Wool, Sportswear, Quick 30, Duvet, Tub Clean, Rinse+Spin, plus downloadable cycles
Intensive, Rinse+, Pre Wash, Delay End, Add Item, Child Lock, Beep On/Off
LG ThinQ with Wi-Fi, Smart Diagnosis, remote start and cycle monitor, energy monitoring

hotspots.title: AI Direct Drive
hotspots.text: Senses the weight and the softness of the fabric and picks the best wash motions for it, in the Cotton, Mixed Fabric and Easy Care programmes.

hotspots.title: Inverter Direct Drive
hotspots.text: The motor drives the drum directly, for less vibration and less noise. LG gives a 10 year warranty on the motor.

hotspots.title: Steam with Allergy Care
hotspots.text: Steam activates the Allergy Care programme, which removes allergens; Baby Steam Care uses steam too.

hotspots.title: Smart Diagnosis and ThinQ
hotspots.text: Quickly troubleshoot the machine with Smart Diagnosis, and start, watch and add cycles from the LG ThinQ app over Wi-Fi.
